newsitem.title: ITALY: Witness says Italy's Andreotti met mob boss.
newsitem.headline: Witness says Italy's Andreotti met mob boss.

text.p: A hotel barman testified at the Mafia trial of Giulio Andreotti on Wednesday that he saw the former Italian prime minister meet mob boss Benedetto "Nitto" Santapaola in 1979.

Vito Di Maggio testified that the meeting took place in the spring or summer of that year at the Hotel Nettuno in the Sicilian city of Catania where he had been working and where Santapaola had been living.
He said the men met at the hotel and then drove in separate cars to another location.
Di Maggio testified that also present at the meeting was Salvo Lima, a member of the European Parliament who was gunned down in the Sicilian capital of Palermo in 1992.

It was the second alleged meeting between Andreotti and a top Mafia boss which witnesses at his trial have described. Andreotti, seven times prime minister, denies charges that he had been the Mafia's protector in Rome's corridors of power.

Last month, Balduccio Di Maggio, a former Mafia boss himself who turned state's evidence, told the court that Godfather Salvatore "Toto" Riina embraced Andreotti during a meeting in Palermo in 1987 and kissed him once on each cheek.
Santapaola, currently in prison, was captured in May 1993 after 10 years on the run. Riina, who had been a fugitive for 23 years, also was jailed that year.
